recentItems.title: SMARTY PANTS! Fairly Odd Flashback
recentItems.description:
#butchhartman #fairlyoddparents #dannyphantom #nickelodeon 

What happens when Timmy makes a wish to be super smart in order to be as brilliant as his pal AJ? Find out in this SEASON 2 episode of THE FAIRLY ODDPARENTS! This was a great episode to do because we got to explore a lot more of Timmy's world OUTSIDE of the Turner home, including getting more into the character of Mr. Crocker! So sit back, relax and pull your pants up as you dive into this magical episode!

What do you think? Do you agree with my reaction?
